description: Simulated disruption events for the demo. Each event links to the route legs it affects via affected_leg_ids, so the agent can reason about impact and reroute. Times are demo-day timestamps; adjust 'active' or 'starts_at' to control when an event fires during the live demo.

events.headline: Severe delays on the Central line
events.detail: Signal failure between Liverpool Street and Bond Street. Expect delays of around 15 minutes.
events.advice: Consider alternative routes avoiding the Central line between Liverpool Street and Bond Street.

events.headline: Heavy traffic on Victoria Embankment
events.detail: Slow-moving traffic westbound approaching Westminster. Adds ~8 minutes.
events.advice: Car journey already slow and subject to congestion charge; public transport or cycle preferred.

events.headline: Minor cycleway diversion on CS3
events.detail: Short signed diversion near Blackfriars due to maintenance. Minimal time impact.
events.advice: Follow signed diversion; cycle route remains viable and fully step-free.

reroute_logic_hint.comment: Guidance for the agent (not a hard rule). When an active severe event affects the recommended route, prefer an alternative route whose legs are not in any active severe event's affected_leg_ids. Factor in user constraints (e.g. step_free required -> consult accessibility_data.json).
reroute_logic_hint.demo_expected_outcome: route_1 (recommended) is hit by evt_1 (severe Central line delay). Agent should reroute to route_2 (Circle line, direct, unaffected) for transit users, or surface route_3 (cycle) if the user wants step-free + low cost. route_4 (car) is discouraged due to evt_2 + congestion charge.
